26 January
ℹ️ Tiny ($2 Element/Warrior): Upgraded from $1 to $2.
ℹ️ Tiny: New Passive Ability <Grow>.
ℹ️ Naga Siren ($3 Naga/Wizard): Upgraded from $2 to $3.
ℹ️ Bane ($1 Satyr/Faceless/Warlock): Species changed into Satyr/Faceless.
ℹ️ Faceless – Whisper of Darkness: Synergy adjusted from (1) Faceless to (2) Facelesses.
ℹ️ Arcane Boots (T2 ➡️ T3).
ℹ️ Avianas Feather (T3 ➡️ T2).
ℹ️ Fixed a bug where pressing F4 would bring up the team shop interface and allow item purchases.
🔗
Click here to see the full changelog!
31 December
ℹ️ S41 'Glow Among Flowers' Season started! S40 rewards are now available.
ℹ️ Congratulations to '青衣待诏' for winning the S40 Championship!
ℹ️ Ranks have been reset. Players will be 'Unranked' until completing 5 placement matches.
↓ Largo: Base HP decreased (850 ➡️ 800).
↓ Faceless Void - Chronosphere: Attack speed change decreased (30%/40%/50% ➡️ 20%/30%/40%).
↑ Oracle - Fate's Rain: Cooldown decreased (15/12/10s ➡️ 12/10/8s).
↑ Treant Protector - Leech Seed: Duration increased (4s ➡️ 5s), Cooldown decreased (8s ➡️ 8/7/6s).
↑ Venomancer: Plague Ward attack interval decreased (1.4s ➡️ 1.2s).
↑ Broodmother: Spiderling attack damage increased (70/90/130 ➡️ 80/120/160) and attack interval decreased (1.5s ➡️ 1.2s).
↑ Snapfire - Lil' Shredder: Damage per shot increased (100/150/200 ➡️ 150/200/250).
↓ Anti-Mage - Mana Break: Damage coefficient decreased (4/6/10 ➡️ 2/4/8).
↓ Morphling: Base attack interval increased (1.3s ➡️ 1.4s).
↑ Warlock Synergy: HP to Mana conversion ratio increased (20%/40% ➡️ 25%/50%).
↓ (6) Naga - Scaled: Damage ratio decreased (1.5x ➡️ 1.0x absorbed damage), Blast radius increased (350 ➡️ 400).
↓ (4) Monk - Drunken Brawler: Now only triggers on enemies with HP higher than 40%.
↑ Mekansm: Cooldown decreased (12s ➡️ 10s).
↑ Witless Shako, Ascetic's Cap, Ogre Hat: Added +25% Magic Resistance.
ℹ️ Fixed (6) Warrior armor bonus description/value bug (Now correctly +10).
ℹ️ Fixed Anti-Mage Mana Break stun duration display bug (Should be 0.5s).
ℹ️ Fixed Gossamer Cape description: Both owner and summons now correctly share the effect.
23 December
↑ Tusk: Base damage increased (60 ➡️ 70).
↑ Muerta: Base damage increased (65 ➡️ 75).
↑ Enigma - Midnight Pulse: Radius increased (300/350/400 ➡️ 350/400/450).
↑ Lycan - Shapeshift: Wolfling's damage increased (75/125/175 ➡️ 75/150/225).

↓ Pandaren - Hospitality: Invited pieces can only sell for Level/2 instead of full price.
↓ Assassin - Coup de Grace: (9) Assassins 5% Chance for critical strike removed.
↓ Kobold - Divided we stand: (3) Kobolds reshaped pieces duration changed to 30s (instead of permanent).

↑ Drum of Endurance: Attack speed bonus increased (30% ➡️ 35%).
↓ Manta Style: Cooldown increased (25s ➡️ 30s).
↓ Gleipnir: Magical damage decreased (200 ➡️ 100).
ℹ️ Fixed a bug where Ogre Magi's Multicast aura sometimes worked on the bench.
ℹ️ Fixed a bug where Dragon pieces from Wonder Wheel could start with 100 mana.
ℹ️ Fixed a bug where Courier level >15 granted 2 Strength, causing HP to exceed 100.
ℹ️ Increased recruitment panel refresh interval to fix crashes/black screens caused by rapid refreshing.
ℹ️ New arrival in Candy Collection: Xmas Eve (Rare Chessboard).
20 December
ℹ️ 3 New Leaderboards arrived.
ℹ️ New Chess Piece: Largo ($2 Naga/Monk), Ability: <Frogstomp>.
ℹ️ Brewmaster ($2 ➡️ $1).
ℹ️ Pandaren – Hospitality. (1)(2) Pandaren’s chance for inviting rebalaced from 12%/12% to 10%/15%
ℹ️ Minotaur Horn (T3 ➡️ T4). Carrier counts as Dragon, and has an initial mana of 100.
ℹ️ Mango Tree reworked: Golden Mango drops only if alive at expiration; Health increased (7 ➡️ 8).
↓ Magic Box: Stacks decreased (15 ➡️ 12).
↓ Talent - Ascendency: +1 level recruitment chances decreased (75% ➡️ 60%).
ℹ️ Fixed a bug where the cooldown of Tidehunter's Ravage was incorrect due to a DOTA 2 update.
